post.author: narendramodi
post.title:
Shri Ratan Tata Ji was a visionary business leader, a compassionate soul and an extraordinary human being. 

One of the most unique aspects of Shri Ratan Tata Ji was his passion towards dreaming big and giving back. He was at the forefront of championing causes like education, healthcare, sanitation, animal welfare to name a few.

Extremely pained by his passing away. My thoughts are with his family, friends and admirers in this sad hour. Om Shanti.

(Sharing an old picture of one of our meetings)

post.author: narendramodi
post.title:
India mourns the loss of one of its most distinguished leaders, Dr. Manmohan Singh Ji. Rising from humble origins, he rose to become a respected economist. He served in various government positions as well, including as Finance Minister, leaving a strong imprint on our economic policy over the years. His interventions in Parliament were also insightful. As our Prime Minister, he made extensive efforts to improve people’s lives. 

Dr. Manmohan Singh Ji and I interacted regularly when he was PM and I was the CM of Gujarat. We would have extensive deliberations on various subjects relating to governance. His wisdom and humility were always visible. 

In this hour of grief, my thoughts are with the family of Dr. Manmohan Singh, his friends and countless admirers. Om Shanti.

(Sharing some glimpses from our interactions)
